providers.title: Convergence action
providers.scope: Every sequence of pairwise distinct elements has a subsequence that maps each closed set avoiding one point into any neighbourhood of another point, for almost all terms.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Collapsing sequences
providers.scope: Inverses collapse with the exchanged pair; the pair is unique on a space with at least three points; left and right translates collapse with the translated pairs.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Elliptic, parabolic, loxodromic
providers.scope: In a convergence group on a compact metric space with at least three points, the fixed points of an element of infinite order are the one or two points of any collapsing sequence of its powers.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Parabolic dynamics
providers.scope: All powers of a parabolic element with exponents tending to infinity in absolute value collapse to its fixed point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Loxodromic dynamics
providers.scope: The positive powers of a loxodromic element collapse from its repelling to its attracting fixed point, without passing to a subsequence.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fundamental domain
providers.scope: A power of a loxodromic element has a compact set whose translates cover the complement of the two fixed points.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite index
providers.scope: The cyclic group of a loxodromic element has finite index in the group of elements fixing both of its fixed points.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One fixed point gives both
providers.scope: An element that fixes one fixed point of a loxodromic element fixes the other.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Point stabilizers
providers.scope: The stabilizer of a point is virtually infinite cyclic and contains a loxodromic element, or consists of elliptic and parabolic elements.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Quotients of convergence actions
providers.scope: A continuous surjective equivariant map between compact metric spaces carries collapsing sequences to collapsing sequences; so the image of a convergence action is a convergence action.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fixed points in a quotient
providers.scope: For an element of infinite order, the fixed points in the image are the images of its fixed points.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Minimal actions
providers.scope: An action is minimal exactly when all orbits are dense; minimality passes to equivariant images; a minimal action on more than one point has no fixed point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The action on the dendrite quotient
providers.scope: A group of homeomorphisms of a compact connected metric space acts on the completion of an invariant set of cut points and on the dendrite quotient; a convergence action gives a convergence action on the dendrite quotient.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Supports
providers.scope: The support in the space of a point of the completion that is not a cut point consists of the points mapped to it and of the cut points adjacent to it.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Supports meet in at most one point
providers.scope: The supports of two different points of the completion are disjoint or meet in one cut point, which is one of the two points or adjacent to both.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No fixed point
providers.scope: A minimal action on a compact connected metric space fixes no point of the completion of a nonempty invariant set of cut points.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Parabolic elements in the completion
providers.scope: A parabolic element of a convergence group whose fixed point is not one of the chosen cut points fixes exactly one point of the completion, which is not a cut point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Loxodromic elements in the completion
providers.scope: The points of the completion of an invariant set of cut points fixed by a loxodromic element form at most three points next to each other, or exactly two points without neighbours that lie between no two points and whose supports are the two fixed points of the element.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fixed-point property for trees
providers.scope: A group has the fixed-point property for trees with finite edge stabilizers if each of its actions on a tree without inversions and with finite edge stabilizers fixes a point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Contracting edges of a tree
providers.scope: Identifying the ends of the edges in a given set turns a tree into a tree whose edges are the remaining edges; an action that respects the set passes to the quotient with the same edge stabilizers.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A bipartite tree
providers.scope: A group with the fixed-point property that acts on a tree with an invariant bipartition, such that at each point of one part at most one edge has an infinite stabilizer, fixes a point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No invariant class of finite intervals
providers.scope: For a minimal convergence action of a group with the fixed-point property, and an invariant set of cut points whose stabilizers are finite or contain loxodromic elements, no class of the finite interval relation of the completion is invariant.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
